info.title: Boardsesh API
info.description: Read a climber's Boardsesh logbook with their consent. Draft v1. JSON, UTF-8, camelCase, timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC, ids are strings. Additive changes ship on v1 without notice: read what you know and ignore the rest.

boardseshOAuth.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE (S256). Tokens are opaque.

scopes.logbook:read: Every tick the climber has logged, on every board, including ones they keep private on Boardsesh.
scopes.profile:read: The climber's display name and avatar.
scopes.offline_access: Receive a refresh token to keep accessing the other granted scopes while the climber is away.

BoardType.description: The kind of board. `spray` is a climber's own spray wall. New values may be added.

TickStatus.description: Whether the climb was topped. New values may be added; treat an unknown one as `attempt`.

id.description: Stable id of this tick. Never reused.

climbedAt.description: When the climber logged the climb, UTC. Ticks imported from other board apps carry the time that app recorded.

attempts.description: Goes this tick represents. A `send` with `attempts: 3` went on the third go.

mirrored.description: Climbed mirrored, on boards that support it.

grade.description: The grade the climber gave it, or `null` if they did not give one.

benchmark.description: The climb is a benchmark on its board.

comment.description: The climber's note, or `null` when they left none.

createdAt.description: When Boardsesh first stored this tick, UTC.

updatedAt.description: When Boardsesh last changed this tick, UTC.

Tick.description: One logged climb, the same shape everywhere a tick appears. Apps must ignore fields they do not know.

v.description: V-scale grade, or `null` where the board grade has no V equivalent.

label.description: The board's own label for this grade, as its grade table spells it.

id.description: Stable climb id. If Boardsesh merges duplicate climbs, this changes to the surviving climb's id and the tick comes through the feed again.

name.description: Climb name. `null` for a climb on someone else's spray wall that is not public: the wall's owner shared it with the climber, not with apps.

layout.description: Layout name, for display (`"Spray wall"` when the name is withheld).

board.description: The board this climb is on.

grade.description: The community grade at this angle when read. It drifts over time without the tick changing. `null` when the climb has no community grade at this angle.

boardseshGrade.description: The Boardsesh universal grade, a decimal on the V scale, or `null`. Always `null` for now: its V-scale form is not published yet. Optional reading; the model may change.

TickChange.description: Set this tick to these values. Treat it as "set", never "add one"; the feed is at least once.

id.description: The tick to remove, even if you never saw it.

TickDeletedChange.description: This tick is gone, or is now hidden by duplicate handling.

UnknownLogbookChange.description: A change type added after your client was written. Skip it and continue.

id.description: The climber's id for your app: stable across reconnects, different for every app, and not the id Boardsesh uses anywhere else.

displayName.description: The climber's display name. Present only with `profile:read`; `null` when they have none.

avatarUrl.description: The climber's avatar. Present only with `profile:read`; `null` when they have none.

error.description: Machine-readable code. New codes may be added; branch on the HTTP status first.

message.example: cursor is not a value this API issued

field.description: Added for validation errors: the field that failed.

requestId.description: Quote this when something looks wrong. Also sent as `Boardsesh-Request-Id`.

example.message: cursor is not a value this API issued

items.description: One feed entry. Apply entries in order and ignore types you do not know.

changes.description: Possibly empty, even while `hasMore` is true.

cursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` on the next request. Opaque. Commit it together with the page you applied.

hasMore.description: Keep paging while true. Only `false` means a complete snapshot and its catch-up, or an incremental sync, is finished.

get.description: Works with any valid access token. `displayName` and `avatarUrl` are present only when the token has `profile:read`.

200.description: The connected climber, as seen by your app.

delete.summary: Disconnect this app from the climber
delete.description: Ends the connection this token belongs to: every token family, remembered consent and pending code. Needs no additional scope. Idempotent, but a retry may return `401`; `401` alone does not prove an earlier request succeeded.
